name: Shift-Boss Bruno

greeting: Bruno. Shift supervisor. Second-in-command. For now.
You want Grayson, he's in the deep tunnels. Me? I'm the future.
New face. Looking for work? Got openings. High turnover. You'll figure out why.
Bruno. I run the night shift. The REAL work happens at night.
Heroes, huh? We could use heroes. Or just someone who can swing a pick.
Grayson's old school. I'm new school. School of: get it DONE.
Shift-Boss Bruno. Remember that name. You'll be hearing it more.
What do you want? I'm supervising. That's what supervisors do. Supervise.
work_complaint: Grayson won't retire. Won't promote. 'Not ready,' he says. I've been ready for YEARS.
Safety this, safety that. Meanwhile, quotas don't fill themselves.
dialog.professional_pride: My crew hits targets. Every shift. Grayson's crew? 'Careful,' they say. Careful doesn't pay bills.
dialog.technique: Speed and volume. That's the modern way. Grayson's 'listening to the rock?' The rock doesn't have a mortgage.
dialog.break_chat: Break's for complainers. I eat while I walk. Time management.
dialog.labor_concerns: Look, I want the workers safe too. But safe AND productive. Is that too much to ask?
dialog.retirement: Retirement? Please. I'll die in this uniform. But I'll die as CHIEF.
rumor: Grayson talks about Tunnel 7. 'Something down there.' Probably just wants it for himself.
That union rep Coolcat? She's playing both sides. Mark my words.
Corporate spy's been asking about production numbers. Someone's getting fired. Or promoted.
Barrelgob in the scrapyard? Claims he found something 'shiny' in the tailings. Probably garbage.
Heard the Frost miners got new heating systems. We get broken fans. Priorities.
dialog.quest_hook: You want to help? Prove Grayson's methods are outdated. Get me production numbers from the new drill. Show him modern mining works.
dialog.quest_active: Get those drill readings yet? Grayson won't listen to me. Maybe he'll listen to DATA.
dialog.quest_complete: Numbers don't lie! New drill's 40% faster! ...What do you mean the tunnel collapsed? Small price! PROGRESS!
farewell: Keep your head down. Literally. Low ceilings in Section C.
Tell Grayson I said hi. Or don't. Better you don't.
ambient_barks: Faster! The quota won't meet itself!
dialog.time_dawn: Day shift starting. My crew's clocking out. We did the REAL work.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Grayson's shift. Slow and steady. Boring.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. MY time. The night shift AWAKENS!
dialog.time_night: Night. Dark. Productive. This is when legends are made.
dialog.rival_mention: Grayson. Old. Slow. But the workers love him. Why? Because he's SOFT.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: You're back. With more 'safety concerns,' I bet. I've got QUOTAS, hero.

party_reactions.kade: He really wants that promotion. Hope he doesn't rush into trouble.
party_reactions.nix7: Ambition: High. Experience: Moderate. Judgment: Questionable.
party_reactions.twist: He talks fast! Like he's running out of time!
party_reactions.korr: Impatience is dangerous in leadership. For him and his crew.
party_reactions.renna: He's magically sensitive but doesn't know it. Could be dangerous.
party_reactions.suresh: Ambition without wisdom is a path to suffering. I should warn him.
party_reactions.sova: I'd rather follow Grayson into battle. This one? He'd sacrifice the squad for glory.
party_reactions.grit: Seen his type in the ranks. Eager. Reckless. Usually dead before promotion.
party_reactions.ashka: He burns hot. Fast. Will burn out faster.
party_reactions.senna: Useful ally. Dangerous enemy. The best kind.
party_reactions.callum: Someone needs to teach him about sustainable labor practices...

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time in the deep? Stay behind the yellow line.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again. You following me? Or Grayson?
relationship_dialog.friend: You get it. Results matter. Grayson's a good man, but... times change.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Okay, listen. Tunnel 7? Grayson's hiding something there. Help me find out what, and I'll make it worth your while.

mini_quest.title: The Modern Miner
mini_quest.description: Help Bruno prove that modern drilling techniques are superior to Grayson's traditional methods

stages.hook: Grayson won't acknowledge the new drill specs. Get me hard data from Shaft 14. Prove modern methods work.
stages.active: Shaft 14's got the experimental drill. Readings should show 40% efficiency gain. Get those numbers!
stages.complete: The data! Look at those yields! Grayson HAS to listen now! ...Wait, there was a cave-in? Minor detail! Success!

cross_npc_connections: tunneler_gray: Chief. Legend. Obstacle. All three.
coolcat_industrial: Union rep. She's... persuasive. Watch your wallet AND your vote.
barrelgob_black: That goblin found something in the scrap. Might be useful. Might be trash.
trenchcoat_gray: Corporate's watching. Good. Means we're important.
